label: See what's on this node
description: Its status, installed apps, spaces, contexts, members and files, and what the app registry offers.

label: Install and update apps
description: Install a published app, or a newer version of one, from the app registry.

label: Uninstall apps
description: Remove an app from this node.

label: Create spaces and groups
description: Start a space for an app, a group inside one, or a context to work in, and give a context a name.

label: Join spaces you're invited to
description: Accept an invitation to a space, or join an open group or a context in a space you're in.

label: Invite people
description: Make an invitation to a space, or add people to a group.

label: Open or close groups
description: Let everyone in a space join a group, or only the people added to it.

label: Rename groups
description: Change a group's name and details.

label: Upload files
description: Store a file on this node, for an app to use.

label: Leave spaces
description: Leave a space and every group in it. Coming back takes a new invitation.

label: Delete spaces, contexts and files
description: Delete a space, a context and its data, or a stored file.
